notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle by discarding a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
